faq: Can you work from my logo?
Yes. Share your artwork and intended size. Fine strokes and small spaces need review before we confirm the construction.
What affects the halo on my wall?
Wall colour and texture, spacing, surrounding light and viewing angle affect the visible glow. Share close and wider photos of the location.
How is my sign quoted?
We review the artwork, dimensions, finish, lighting, quantity and delivery requirements. Final specifications and installation responsibilities are agreed for your project.
Can I choose warm or cool halo lighting?
Tell us your preferred light colour and send wall and room photos. We review the appearance with the selected finish and confirm the actual lighting configuration before production.
Why can the halo look different on another wall?
Wall colour, texture, reflectivity, letter spacing and stand-off distance affect the visible glow. A concept photo does not establish the halo for an unreviewed wall.
Where do the cables and power supply go?
Plan cable exits and an accessible power-supply position with your installer. The fixing, cable route and supplied components are confirmed in the project scope.
technicalNotes: Choose the light
Compare warm, neutral or cool white against the wall and surrounding lighting. Agree the actual light colour for your order.
Choose the visible finish
Brushed, painted or plated appearances change the character of the same logo. Confirm the face and side finish with an approved reference.
Plan the halo & wiring
Wall texture, stand-off distance and letter spacing affect light spread. Resolve cable exits, driver location and maintenance access before the wall is finished.

faq: Can I use my own logo or typeface?
Share the artwork and intended dimensions so the strokes, spacing and construction can be reviewed.
Can this style be used outdoors?
Suitability depends on the specific construction, components and site conditions. Tell us the location before the specification is confirmed.
What determines the price?
Design, dimensions, materials, lighting, quantity and delivery requirements are reviewed together for your quote.
Can the faces match my brand colour?
Share a colour reference and artwork. We review the material and illuminated appearance; colour matching and any approval sample are confirmed for your quoted configuration.
Do I need individual fixings or a raceway?
This depends on the fascia, cable access, local installation requirements and desired appearance. Send site photos and substrate details so the mounting approach can be reviewed.
Is exterior suitability the same for every letter?
No. Tell us the site exposure and destination. Materials, components, required documentation and the electrical and mounting scope are reviewed for the order.
technicalNotes: Face, returns & depth
The light-transmitting face and formed side work as one letter. Review the face colour, depth, edges and the smallest artwork details.
Day and evening appearance
Compare the face colour in daylight with its illuminated appearance. Viewing distance and nearby lighting inform the brightness review.
Fascia, fixings & power
Identify the substrate, any carrier or raceway requirement, cable penetrations and access for the power supply. Site and destination requirements must be agreed.

faq: Are metal letters always illuminated?
No. This direction can use natural light and shadow. Any illumination is a separate construction choice to review.
Can you match a finish reference?
Send a finish or colour reference. Material, coating availability and sample requirements need confirmation.
How are the letters mounted?
The fixing method depends on the lettering, wall and installation arrangements. Supplied parts and local site work are agreed in the order scope.
Can I choose a thin cut letter or a deeper built-up letter?
Yes, these are different construction directions. Share the artwork, size and desired depth so we can review feasibility, edge detail and fixing.
Will the metal finish look exactly like a screen image?
Lighting, viewing angle and screen settings change perceived colour and sheen. Request a finish reference or approval option when matching the surface is important.
Can unlit metal lettering be used outside?
Identify the environment and fixing surface first. The actual metal, finish and attachment method must be selected for the agreed location and exposure.
technicalNotes: Cut or built-up
Artwork and required depth guide the choice between cut material and a formed dimensional construction. Small strokes and fixing details need review at size.
Surface & environment
Compare sheen, brushing direction and colour with a finish reference. Identify outdoor, coastal or other exposure before choosing the actual metal and surface treatment.
Shadow & attachment
Unlit letters depend on daylight or site lighting. Review wall clearance, stud positions and attachment to the actual wall or cladding with your installer.

faq: Are acrylic letters always illuminated?
No. Acrylic can be used in non-illuminated lettering or in an illuminated construction. Tell us the effect you want.
Can you reproduce fine logo details?
Send the artwork and intended size. Small features, thin strokes and layer alignment need review.
Can I choose the colour and thickness?
Share your preferences. Available material colours, thicknesses and the final design are confirmed for your project.
Can a logo combine clear and solid-colour layers?
Share the artwork and a side-view or layering reference. We review layer thickness, alignment, visible edges and assembly before confirming the design.
Can acrylic lettering also be illuminated?
Yes, an illuminated direction can be reviewed, but it requires an appropriate construction. Tell us whether you want an unlit, front-lit, edge-lit or other effect.
Can the sign be fixed without drilling?
Tell us about the surface and fixing restrictions. Any adhesive, stud or backing solution must be reviewed for the material, weight and local installation conditions.
technicalNotes: Colour & transparency
Identify opaque, clear and translucent areas in the artwork. Approve the material or painted colour reference rather than relying only on a screen image.
Thickness & layers
Review overall thickness, layer alignment, fine details and exposed edge treatment. Clear layers and visible edges can be deliberate parts of the design.
Wall & fixing limits
Tell us if drilling is restricted. Studs, adhesives and backing options must be selected for the sign, surface and local installation conditions.

faq: Can you make my logo in either style?
Share the artwork and intended size. Fine details, stroke spacing and the preferred effect need review.
Does neon-style mean glass neon?
Neon-style describes the visual direction here. Confirm the actual light source, backing and construction for your chosen product.
Can a projecting lightbox be installed at my site?
Tell us about the facade, access and local installation arrangements. Structural fixing and electrical requirements must be reviewed for the project.
How do I choose between a lightbox and a neon-style sign?
Choose a lightbox direction for an illuminated graphic panel, or a neon-style direction for visible light lines and lettering. Share the viewing position and artwork if you are unsure.
Can a lightbox be viewed from both sides?
Request the required viewing directions in your enquiry. The face arrangement, bracket, cabinet and fixing need to be designed together for the location.
Can the light colour or brightness be changed?
State the light colour and any dimming or control needs before quoting. Availability depends on the selected system and the agreed power and component configuration.
technicalNotes: Panel or illuminated line
A lightbox displays graphics through a lit face. A neon-style sign follows the strokes in the artwork. These effects use different construction approaches.
Backing, cabinet & viewing
For a lightbox, review face count, cabinet depth and viewing direction. For a line sign, review backing shape, bend detail and visible fixings.
Power & site conditions
Confirm cable exit, accessible power-supply location and indoor or outdoor use. Any dimming, control or documentation requirement belongs in the quoted configuration.

faq: Can you work from a reference photo?
Yes. A photo explains the look, but may not show its materials or construction. We review the design and scope before confirming what can be made.
Can you copy a design exactly?
An exact match cannot be assumed from a photograph. Artwork rights, materials, dimensions and construction all need review.
What should I send for a feasibility review?
Share a reference, the important visual details, approximate size, quantity, intended location and destination.
Can one sign combine an emblem, illuminated text and unlit lettering?
Share the full visual reference and indicate the desired effect for each part. We review the construction, finishes, support and electrical scope as one proposed assembly.
Can the exposed light points be replaced later?
Identify the maintenance requirement at the enquiry stage. Component selection and service access need to be incorporated into the approved construction.
Can you manufacture directly from a photograph?
A photo is useful for discussing the direction, but dimensions, artwork, construction and supplied items still need to be resolved and approved before production.
technicalNotes: Resolve the visual idea
Start with artwork or a reference and identify which parts need depth, illumination or a particular surface. The drawing must define the proposed combination.
Component layout & access
For exposed lighting, review point spacing, component choice and replacement access. For mixed constructions, identify how the individual parts connect and are supported.
Confirm the supplied scope
Review overall size, fixing, electrical arrangement, exposure and destination requirements. Approve the drawings and required components before production.
